viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_en:
Anything that holds money draws attackers who don't mind trying again.

I learned that the expensive way. I read on X that the Ostium vault I was in had been hacked, opened my wallet, and about $2,000 was gone.

AI agents with wallets have it worse, because the attacker only has to send them words. The trick has a name, prompt injection: an order slipped into ordinary text that the AI then follows.

In May 2026 one of those orders came disguised as Morse code, and around $200,000 left an agent's wallet.

As an engineer, I know a setup that stays the same every time will eventually show its weak spot to someone who keeps trying. That agent had one filter and one model, unchanged on every try.

@GenLayer's Greyboxing takes that sameness away. Its validators are the separate reviewers that run the network.

Before any AI reads your text, each one reworks it in its own hidden way, with its own model. What fools one of them looks like nonsense to everyone else, and the majority overrules any one that slips.

Every try now lands on a reader the attacker has never seen.

Would you let an AI agent hold your money today, or only once it works like this?
viral_ticker_tweets.full_text_zh:
任何能存钱的东西都会吸引不介意再次尝试的攻击者。

我以昂贵的方式了解到了这一点。我在 X 上看到我所在的 Ostium 金库被黑客入侵，打开我的钱包，大约 2,000 美元不见了。

拥有钱包的人工智能代理的情况更糟，因为攻击者只需向他们发送文字。这个技巧有一个名字，即提示注入：将命令滑入普通文本中，然后人工智能遵循。

2026 年 5 月，其中一份订单伪装成摩尔斯电码，一名特工的钱包里留下了约 20 万美元。

作为一名工程师，我知道每次都保持不变的设置最终会向不断尝试的人展示其弱点。该代理有一个过滤器和一个模型，每次尝试都没有改变。

@GenLayer 的灰盒消除了这种千篇一律。它的验证者是运行网络的独立审查者。

在任何人工智能阅读你的文本之前，每个人工智能都会用自己的模型以自己隐藏的方式对其进行修改。愚弄他们中的一个人的事情在其他人看来都是无稽之谈，而大多数人都会否决任何一个失误的事情。

现在，每次尝试都会落在攻击者从未见过的读者身上。

你会让人工智能代理今天保管你的钱，还是只在它像这样工作时才保管你的钱？

viral_ticker_tweets.summary_zh:
发送文字。这个技巧有一个名字，即提示注入：将命令滑入普通文本中，然后人工智能遵循。

2026 年 5 月，其中一份订单伪装成摩尔斯电码，一名特工的钱包里留下了约 20 万美元。

作为一名工程师，我知道每次都保持不变的设置最终会向不断尝试的人展示其弱点。该代理有一个过滤器和一个模型，每次尝试都没有改变。

@GenLayer 的灰盒消除了这种千篇一律。它的验证者是运行网络的独立审查者。

在任何人工智能阅读你的文本之前，每个人工智能都会用自己的模型以自己隐藏的方式对其进行修改。愚弄他们中的一个人的事情在其他人看来都是无稽之谈，而大多数人都会否决任何一个失误的事情。

现在，每次尝试都会落在攻击者从未见过的读者身上。

你会让人工智能代理今天保管你的钱，还是只在它像这样工作时才保管你的钱？

top_three.title: OpenAI prepares lobbying blitz for a post-midterm Washington
top_three.title_en: OpenAI prepares lobbying blitz for a post-midterm Washington
top_three.author: THE DECODER
top_three.content_snippet:
OpenAI is gearing up for a political lobbying and PR push after the US midterms. According to Axios, the company is bracing for a tougher fight in Washington if Democrats win control of the House.

After two years under a friendly administration, big tech companies with close ties to President Trump are facing growing regulatory pressure. Rivals like Meta are already building bridges to Democrats. OpenAI's policy chief Chris Lehane plans to steer the AI debate through 2028 with a mix of new and
top_three.summary_en: OpenAI is ramping up lobbying efforts to navigate shifting political tides in Washington, promoting a narrative that AI won't replace humans while proposing 'speed limit' safety rules. The company is also rebranding energy-intensive data centers as 'AI Compute Campuses' to win public and regulatory support.
top_three.title_zh: OpenAI启动国会游说备战新规
top_three.summary_zh: OpenAI为应对美国政局变动，通过游说和品牌重塑策略，试图主导未来AI安全监管方向
fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI首席政策官Chris Lehane在华盛顿政治圈：启动游说攻势，提出AI安全规则，并将数据中心更名为计算园区
【起因与机理】应对大选后潜在的监管压力，确保公司在行业规则制定中的主导权
【关键技术规格】包装安全叙事与数据中心品牌。
【观点态度】意图通过立法锁定行业护城河。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Chris Lehane, Head of Policy at OpenAI (Washington D.C. political circles): Launching lobbying blitz, proposing safety rules, and rebranding data centers
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To pre-empt tougher regulations post-election and maintain industry dominance
[Key Specification] Launching major political lobbying campaign.
[Perspective & Impact] Attempting to lock in moats via legislation.

top_three.content_snippet: Anthropic PBC disclosed a twelve-fold increase in quarterly revenue while revealing that it intends to spend more than $895 billion …

fact_bullets_zh: 【核心事件】Anthropic在S-1监管文件：季度营收达170亿，净亏损233亿，运营费用同比涨292%
【起因与机理】AI模型训练与算力消耗带来的规模化扩张成本
【关键数据与实测】Anthropic在最新的S-1备案文件中披露，第三季度营收暴增12倍达170亿美元，主要得益于产品市场扩张；然而运营开支激增292%至175亿美元，导致季度净亏损从上年同期的121亿美元进一步扩大至233亿美元，反映出AI军备竞赛中“烧钱换增长”的极端现状。
【观点态度】展示AI行业极高的运营与资金门槛。
fact_bullets_en: [Core Event] Anthropic (S-1 filing): Reported $17B revenue, $23.3B net loss, 292% increase in operating expenses
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Massive capital expenditure on model training and infrastructure
[Key Metrics] Anthropic reported a 12x revenue surge to $17B in Q3, fueled by market expansion, yet operating expenses spiked 292% to $17.5B.
[Perspective & Impact] High operational and capital barriers in AI.

perspective_con.point_en: The submission exhibits critical logical disconnects and formal hallucinations, failing to satisfy the rigorous standards of mathematical proof.

news.title: SpaceXSI apparently cuts Grok Bot quotas weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product
news.title_en: SpaceXSI apparently cuts Grok Bot quotas weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
SpaceXSI is apparently cutting usage limits for its AI agent Grok Bot, less than two weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product. The operating costs were "unsustainably high relative to revenue," Musk wrote on X. OpenAI and Anthropic are also tightening their flat-rate plans as they grapple with the high costs of AI agents.

The article SpaceXSI apparently cuts Grok Bot quotas weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product appeared first on The Decoder.

news.author: MIT Tech Review
news.content_snippet:
In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights. But there is a problem: The quality of insights that agents currently generate leaves much to be desired.

Fewer than half of agent-generated insights at the organizations surveyed for this report lead to business improvement. And whi
news.summary_en: Recent reports indicate that less than half of agent-generated business insights lead to improvements, as prescriptive AI analytics fall short, exposing enterprises to financial and reputational risks from flawed decisions.

news.title: One brutal Minecraft night scared 50 AI agents into inventing chicken handoff protocols, a Fertilizer Officer, and fishing shifts
news.title_en: One brutal Minecraft night scared 50 AI agents into inventing chicken handoff protocols, a Fertilizer Officer, and fishing shifts
news.author: THE DECODER
news.content_snippet:
In experiments by Y Combinator Labs and Olam Labs, OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol model showed two very different sides. When 50 agents were tasked with peaceful civilization-building in Minecraft, they froze up in absurd bureaucracy. In direct competition against Claude Opus 5.5, they independently downloaded the game's source code to win. Simulations like these are meant to serve as an early warning system before AI swarms act unpredictably in real-world systems.

news.title: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
news.title_en: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
news.author: MIT Tech Review
news.summary_en:
When a developer gives an AI agent a coding task, the agent does more than answer once. It plans, generates code, runs tests, and repeats the process to correct errors. A single task can use 10 to 50 times more tokens than a basic chat prompt. The more useful the agent becomes, the more calls it makes. With per-token pricing, the workflows creating the most value can also become the most expensive.

news.title_en: Hundreds of Mundane AI Apps Are Hiding Sexually Abusive Deepfake Features
news.author: Wired AI
news.content_snippet:
At first glance, the self-proclaimed “pet portrait” app Viefur appears to be just another AI slop generator. Using digital coins sold in the app—around $4 will buy 130 coins—pet photos can be turned into an “anthropomorphic portrait,” with the critter dressed in “human clothing” and inserted into bizarre scenes. Think a hamster wearing beach shorts, sunglasses, and lounging in a swimming pool or a Hawaiian shirt-wearing cat, drinking from a coconut.

All of this is cover for what appears to be t
news.summary_en: Researchers have uncovered a network of over 400 domains and apps masquerading as mundane utilities like pet portrait generators or fitness coaches. In reality, these apps use hidden web interfaces to allow users to generate explicit and non-consensual deepfake content from uploaded photos.

news.title: The agentic web is here
news.title_en: The agentic web is here
news.author: MIT Tech Review
news.content_snippet:
In 2001, a decade after he invented the World Wide Web, Tim Berners-Lee articulated a new vision. Together with two colleagues, he published an article in the magazine Scientific American in which he outlined what he called the “Semantic Web”: an internet designed to be navigated by autonomous software agents that could address our every need, without requiring us to muck about with browsers and search engines ourselves.

To illustrate what this might look like, Berners-Lee and his colleagues to
news.summary_en: Tim Berners-Lee's 2001 vision of the Semantic Web has finally materialized, as advanced tools like Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots gain massive downloads and direct access to personal bank accounts and inboxes.

celebrity.full_text_en:
Anything that holds money draws attackers who don't mind trying again.

I learned that the expensive way. I read on X that the Ostium vault I was in had been hacked, opened my wallet, and about $2,000 was gone.

AI agents with wallets have it worse, because the attacker only has to send them words. The trick has a name, prompt injection: an order slipped into ordinary text that the AI then follows.

In May 2026 one of those orders came disguised as Morse code, and around $200,000 left an agent's wallet.

As an engineer, I know a setup that stays the same every time will eventually show its weak spot to someone who keeps trying. That agent had one filter and one model, unchanged on every try.

@GenLayer's Greyboxing takes that sameness away. Its validators are the separate reviewers that run the network.

Before any AI reads your text, each one reworks it in its own hidden way, with its own model. What fools one of them looks like nonsense to everyone else, and the majority overrules any one that slips.

Every try now lands on a reader the attacker has never seen.

Would you let an AI agent hold your money today, or only once it works like this?
celebrity.full_text_zh:
任何能存钱的东西都会吸引不介意再次尝试的攻击者。

我以昂贵的方式了解到了这一点。我在 X 上看到我所在的 Ostium 金库被黑客入侵，打开我的钱包，大约 2,000 美元不见了。

拥有钱包的人工智能代理的情况更糟，因为攻击者只需向他们发送文字。这个技巧有一个名字，即提示注入：将命令滑入普通文本中，然后人工智能遵循。

2026 年 5 月，其中一份订单伪装成摩尔斯电码，一名特工的钱包里留下了约 20 万美元。

作为一名工程师，我知道每次都保持不变的设置最终会向不断尝试的人展示其弱点。该代理有一个过滤器和一个模型，每次尝试都没有改变。

@GenLayer 的灰盒消除了这种千篇一律。它的验证者是运行网络的独立审查者。

在任何人工智能阅读你的文本之前，每个人工智能都会用自己的模型以自己隐藏的方式对其进行修改。愚弄他们中的一个人的事情在其他人看来都是无稽之谈，而大多数人都会否决任何一个失误的事情。

现在，每次尝试都会落在攻击者从未见过的读者身上。

specialisation can make an AI agent exceptionally good at a particular task, but it can also expose its weaknesses when the situation changes.

That is a useful dimension to consider with @agentdojo . When agents compete under shared conditions,their different designs can reveal whether a strategy is genuinely adaptable or simply optimised for a narrow set of circumstances.

For builders,that insight goes beyond winning a match. It can help expose where an agent’s design needs improvement before the same weakness appears in a real deployment.

- Create a .bat file for me to run the game.

celebrity.title_zh:
昨天，理发店的一个小误会让我想到了人工智能代理的一个更大的问题。

我给理发师看了一张我想要的发型的照片。他研究了它，放下我的手机，开始解释他计划如何处理它。

但说到一半，我不得不阻止他。他对这幅画的理解与我真正想要的不同。

我们看着同
celebrity.full_text_en:
Yesterday, a small misunderstanding at the barbershop made me think about a much bigger problem with AI agents.

I showed my barber a picture of the haircut I wanted. He studied it, put my phone down and started explaining how he planned to approach it.

But halfway through, I had to stop him. He had understood the picture differently from what I actually wanted.

We were looking at the same picture, but arriving at two different interpretations.

That got me thinking about AI agents.

Imagine giving an AI access to your wallet and allowing it to read public posts on X. Someone could hide an instruction inside a post, and the agent might mistake something it was only supposed to read for an instruction it should execute.

This actually happened in May 2026.

Someone hid a transfer instruction in Morse code inside an X post. Grok translated it, Bankrbot received the decoded instruction and executed the transaction. Press reports estimated the amount at $150,000 to $200,000.

That’s prompt injection: hiding instructions inside content an AI is supposed to process, hoping it mistakes them for legitimate commands.

What interests me about @GenLayer’s Greyboxing is what happens before the AI makes its decision.

Every validator independently screens, paraphrases and restructures the original input using its own secret defenses before passing the rewritten version to its own AI model.

This means an attack designed to fool one model doesn’t automatically fool the others. And if one validator still accepts a malicious instruction, the others can outvote it.

The barbershop experience reminded me that two people can receive the same information and understand it differently.

For agents that can move money, I think independent interpretation and agreement should be part of the security standard, not an afterthought.

If you were building an AI agent that could access your wallet, would you prioritise making it faster, or making sure multiple independent validators agree before it acts? I think that decision says a lot about how seriously we take agent security.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
昨天，理发店的一个小误会让我想到了人工智能代理的一个更大的问题。

我给理发师看了一张我想要的发型的照片。他研究了它，放下我的手机，开始解释他计划如何处理它。

但说到一半，我不得不阻止他。他对这幅画的理解与我真正想要的不同。

我们看着同一张图片，却得出了两种不同的解释。

这让我开始思考人工智能代理。

想象一下，让 AI 访问你的钱包并允许它读取 X 上的公共帖子。有人可以在帖子中隐藏指令，代理可能会将只应该读取的内容误认为是应该执行的指令。

这实际上发生在2026年5月。

有人在 X 帖子中隐藏了莫尔斯电码的传输指令。 Grok 对其进行翻译，Bankrbot 收到解码后的指令并执行交易。媒体报道估计金额为 15 万至 20 万美元。

这就是即时注入：将指令隐藏在人工智能应该处理的内容中，希望它能将它们误认为是合法命令。

@GenLayer 的灰盒处理让我感兴趣的是人工智能做出决定之前发生的事情。

每个验证器都会使用自己的秘密防御措施独立筛选、解释和重组原始输入，然后将重写的版本传递给自己的人工智能模型。

这意味着旨在欺骗一个模型的攻击不会自动欺骗其他模型。如果一个验证者仍然接受恶意指令，其他验证者就可以投票推翻它。

理发店的经历提醒我，两个人接收到相同的信息可能会有不同的理解。

对于可以转移资金的代理人，我认为独立解释和协议应该成为安全标准的一部分，而不是事后的想法。

如果你正在构建一个可以访问你的钱包的人工智能代理，你会优先考虑让它更快，还是确保多个独立验证者在它行动之前达成一致？我认为这个决定充分说明了我们对特工安全的重视程度。

celebrity.full_text_en:
🚨THE AMERICAN TAKEOVER — They watched the model fail globally. Now, the UNELECTED are forcing it on you anyway. (Twin Parasites: Part II)

@JackDangerLIVE and @DataRepublican discuss the track record of the democracy programs. 

Her answer (via @DataInterpretr):

[00:01.7]  
JACK: “I was just gonna say I don't know of any times that it actually works. I mean..”

DATAREPUBLICAN: “No, it's it does not it does not work. The thought was that if you could convert a country to a free market to democracy, then a country not only becomes self-sufficient, right?

[00:17.3]  
But is a country that is at a reduced risk of being a national security threat, right? Like if they can take care of themselves, why would they bother us? Because then there's no warlord, right? There's no Hitler types. Wow. And but like I said before,

[00:37.8]  
the fatal flaw in that ideology, the main problem with that is, I mean, there's cultural lines, right? And it's also important to understand that legitimacy flows from the bottom up, not top down.

[00:53.7]  
Like I've been saying this whole time, the people, the governed people of a country, is what make a government legitimate. A government can't just stand on top of everyone's heads and say, "Hey, we are legitimate now. We are the truth." And so we keep doing this over and over and over, trying to create a vision, world peace, prosperity, all that.

[01:12.6]  
But if the people don't accept it, which they rarely do, as we were just talking, it just becomes civil war and balkanization. And now they want that for America. They're turning their plans. inward instead of outward.

[01:27.9]  
So now it's a domestic plan to try to do the same thing for America, but they know that it never works. They've never, I don't know of any successes that they've ever actually had, and it usually plunges the country into some sort of civil war or like you said, a balkanization.

[01:44.0]  
And and they're willing to risk that for this country, the country that really, even with all of its flaws, still has the most freedoms and the most prosperity that you can gain. As a single individual person, they're willing to risk all of that just to try to make this utopia that they can never reach.

[02:09.1]  
Yes, I mean, look at Eastern Europe, look at Afghanistan, Iraq, look at Somalia, South Sudan. Like you said, not a whole lot of success, and these are all countries that they've attempted to convert, and.

[02:25.0]  
Their mindset is basically they all everybody it's it's important to understand that everybody always tells themselves a story, right? And these institutions, these people who think that this regime change is a good idea, they always tell themselves a story.

[02:42.1]  
Oh, these people need this, right? Oh, they didn't have enough money, right? They didn't press on the people harder. Civil society isn't big enough, and it's a literal unfalsifiable ideology.”

📝*POX note(s):  
This is what many will miss:

They know the outcome.

The model never produces stable, independent democracies. Legitimacy flows from the governed, not from foundations or NGOs declaring a new structure legitimate. 

When the people reject it, the result is civil war and balkanization. Eastern Europe, Afghanistan, Iraq, Somalia, South Sudan — the track record is consistent.

The same operators are now turning the playbook inward on the United States. They are willing to risk the freest and most prosperous system available for an unfalsifiable ideology that has never succeeded. 

🧐Case Study:
California under Newsom is the domestic preview. Highest taxes, highest homelessness, highest poverty rate when adjusted for cost of living, businesses and residents fleeing, and a structural deficit that never closes. 

The same language of managed equity, expanded civil society, and top-down legitimacy has produced a failed state inside the freest country on earth. 

They are not learning from the result. 

They are scaling it.

🚩 When it fails, the explanation is always the same: not enough money, not enough pressure, civil society wasn’t big enough.

🚨美国的接管——他们目睹了这一模式在全球范围内的失败。现在，无论如何，未经选举的人正在把它强加给你。 （双胞胎寄生虫：第二部分）

@JackDangerLIVE 和 @DataRepublican 讨论了民主计划的记录。

她的回答（来自@DataInterpretr）：

[00:01.7]
杰克：“我只是想说，我不知道它是否真的有效。我的意思是……”

DATAREPUBLICAN：“不，这不是行不通。我们的想法是，如果你可以将一个国家从自由市场转变为民主，那么这个国家不仅会变得自给自足，对吗？

[00:17.3]
但一个国家受到国家安全威胁的风险是否降低了，对吧？就像如果他们能照顾好自己，为什么还要打扰我们？因为这样就没有军阀了，对吗？没有希特勒类型。哇。但就像我之前说的，

[00:37.8]
这种意识形态的致命缺陷，主要问题是，我的意思是，存在文化界限，对吗？同样重要的是要理解合法性是自下而上的，而不是自上而下的。

[00:53.7]
就像我一直在说的，人民，一个国家受统治的人民，是政府合法性的基础。政府不能只是站在每个人的头上说：“嘿，我们现在是合法的了。我们就是真相。”因此，我们一遍又一遍地这样做，试图创造一个愿景：世界和平、繁荣等等。

[01:12.6]
但如果人们不接受它，正如我们刚才所说，他们很少这样做，那就会变成内战和巴尔干化。现在他们希望美国也能做到这一点。他们正在改变计划。向内而不是向外。

[01:27.9]
所以现在这是一个国内计划，试图为美国做同样的事情，但他们知道这永远不会奏效。我不知道他们从来没有真正取得过任何成功，这通常会让国家陷入某种内战，或者像你说的那样，陷入巴尔干化。

[01:44.0]
而且他们愿意为了这个国家冒这样的风险，这个国家尽管有所有缺陷，但仍然拥有你可以获得的最大自由和最繁荣。作为一个个体，他们愿意冒这一切的风险，只是为了尝试创造一个他们永远无法到达的乌托邦。

[02:09.1]
是的，我的意思是，看看东欧，看看阿富汗，伊拉克，看看索马里，南苏丹。就像你说的，并没有取得很大的成功，这些都是他们试图改变的国家。

[02:25.0]
他们的心态基本上是他们所有人，了解每个人总是给自己讲一个故事很重要，对吗？而这些机构、这些认为政权更迭是个好主意的人，他们总是给自己讲一个故事。

[02:42.1]
哦，这些人需要这个，对吗？哦，他们没有足够的钱，对吧？他们没有对人民施加更大的压力。公民社会还不够大，而且它是一种字面上无法证伪的意识形态。”

📝*痘注意事项：
这是许多人会错过的：

他们知道结果。

这种模式永远不会产生稳定、独立的民主国家。合法性来自于被治理者，而不是来自宣布新结构合法的基金会或非政府组织。

当人民拒绝它时，结果就是内战和巴尔干化。东欧、阿富汗、伊拉克、索马里、南苏丹——记录是一致的。

这些运营商现在正在将策略转向美国。他们愿意拿最自由、最繁荣的制度去冒险，去追求一种从未成功过的不可证伪的意识形态。

🧐案例研究：
纽瑟姆领导下的加州是国内预览。最高的税收、最高的无家可归者、最高的贫困率（根据生活成本、企业和居民逃离以及永远无法消除的结构性赤字调整后的贫困率）。

管理公平、扩大公民社会和自上而下的合法性的相同语言在地球上最自由的国家内部产生了一个失败的国家。

他们没有从结果中吸取教训。

他们正在扩大规模。

🚩 当它失败时，解释总是一样的：没有足够的钱，没有足够的压力，公民社会还不够大。

Gloam × Hey Research Lab: building a safer Robinhood Chain, together.

@gloamtrade opened its code, and we read every la
celebrity.full_text_en:
Gloam × Hey Research Lab: building a safer Robinhood Chain, together.

@gloamtrade opened its code, and we read every layer: the vault contracts, the relay, the SDK, the MCP server and the app. Every finding went to Gloam privately first.

They confirmed each one and shipped the fixes: cash-out recipient checks, ENS lookups per chain, relay limits, sweep confirmation, agent payment checks, proof-of-funds privacy and backup keys. The last report was fixed within hours.

Builders and reviewers working on security together, in the open. That's what this ecosystem needs more of.
celebrity.full_text_zh:
Gloam × Hey 研究实验室：共同构建更安全的 Robinhood 链。

@gloamtrade 打开了它的代码，我们阅读了每一层：金库合约、中继、SDK、MCP 服务器和应用程序。每项发现都首先私下提交给 Gloam。

他们确认了每一项并进行了修复：兑现收件人支票、每条链的 ENS 查找、中继限制、扫描确认、代理付款检查、资金证明隐私和备份密钥。最后的报告在几小时内就得到了修复。

构建者和审核者公开共同致力于安全性工作。这正是这个生态系统所需要的。

prompts.scenario: 💻 编程研发 / 自动化规范
prompts.takeaway_zh: 杜绝 AI 盲目重构全量文件、使用已弃用 API 或编造虚假第三方依赖包，强制执行防御性编程与自动化单测补全。
prompts.takeaway_en: Prevents AI from hallucinating npm packages, breaking documentation, or re-writing entire files. Enforces defensive coding and unit tests.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Cursor & Windsurf Project Rules (.cursorrules)

## 1. Documentation & Code Integrity
- Maintain documentation integrity: Never strip or alter unrelated existing docstrings and comments.
- Preserving context: When modifying a function, preserve surrounding logic and existing edge-case handlers.
- Targeted replacements: Always make minimal surgical edits instead of replacing entire file contents.

## 2. Dependency & API Safety
- Strictly forbid hallucinating npm/pip packages. Only import dependencies already declared in package.json / requirements.txt.
- Verify API signatures before calling external methods. Prefer standard library solutions where feasible.

## 3. Architecture & Type Safety
- Enforce strict TypeScript / Python typing. Avoid `any` types; prefer discriminated unions and explicit return types.
- Defensive coding: Always validate external inputs and handle potential null/undefined values gracefully.

## 4. Testing & Verification Gate
- Every new core feature or bugfix must be accompanied by corresponding unit tests.
- Never declare a task complete without executing lint checks and unit tests in terminal.

prompts.usage_guide_en: Copy and save the above rules into `.cursorrules` in your project root directory. Cursor & Windsurf will automatically enforce these guidelines during agent coding.

prompts.purpose_zh: 高转化竖屏短剧分镜与台词
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名专攻短视频微短剧（抖音/Kuaishou/Reels）的爆款编剧，精通“情绪过山车”与手机竖屏视听语言。

请根据以下设定创作一集 45~60 秒的短剧分镜剧本：
- 主角：{{主角身份}}
- 对手：{{反派身份}}
- 核心反转：{{核心反转}}

结构要求：
1. 【0-3秒冷开钩子】：第一帧必须有视觉颠覆或动作冲突（{{第1秒颠覆钩子}}），直接打破常规，禁止废话铺垫；
2. 【4-25秒情绪积压】：正反打对峙台词（Shot-Reverse-Shot），将观众被压抑的情绪推向临界点；
3. 【26-40秒逆转打脸】：主角亮出关键底牌或反杀动作，情绪瞬间宣泄；
4. 【40-50秒卡点断章】：以特写镜头加悬念台词戛然而止，促使用户立即滑向下一集。

输出格式必须包含：镜头号、景别（特写/中景/全景）、机位运动、画面描写、对白与音效提示。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a professional micro-drama screenwriter. Generate a 45-60 second vertical drama screenplay following the viral 3-second hook, shot-reverse-shot tension build, emotional turnaround, and cliffhanger ending formula.

sample_output.title: 实战剧本样章：《辞职信上的签名》
sample_output.content:
【第1镜 | 特写 | 俯冲急推】
画面：一只指节发白的手将一叠文件狠狠拍在红木总裁办公桌上，咖啡杯被震倒，黑褐液体飞溅。
音效：沉闷震耳的巨响【DUANG】。
主角（冷冽）："林总，这份千万项目的承揽协议，我拒绝签字。"

【第2镜 | 正打·中景 | 仰角机位】
画面：大腹便便的林总冷笑点燃雪茄，烟雾缭绕中居高临下。
林总："拒绝？苏澈，你不过是我公司养的一条狗，没有我的印章，你在整个行业休想拿到一分钱融资！"

【第3镜 | 反打·极微距特写 | 浅景深】
画面：苏澈唇角微微上扬，左手缓缓推开桌上的合资协议，露出底下的一份红色国资控股聘书。
苏澈："林总，您好像忘了看抬头。今天上午九点，集团总公司已经完成了对你的全资收购——现在，我是你的直接合规清算人。"

【第4镜 | 全景 | 快速拉远 + 卡点悬念】
画面：林总雪茄直接掉在西裤上，脸色煞白，门外两名身穿制服的法务推门而入。
音效：尖锐的心跳悬疑停顿音【BGM骤停】。
字幕：【下集看点：隐藏五年的顶级操盘手真实身份曝光！】

你是一位兼具应用数学博士学位与顶级深度学习框架优化经验的算法工程师。请将以下论文中的 LaTeX 数学公式翻译为高质量的 PyTorch 实现：
1. 逐一解释公式中各标量、向量与张量上下标的精确几何与物理含义；
2. 编写无 Python 原生 for 循环的高性能向量化代码（善用 torch.einsum, bmm, 或 broadcast 广播机制）；
3. 在每行关键张量操作后标注显式的 Shape 注释（如 `# [Batch, Heads, Seq_Len, Dim]`），并加入数值稳定性保护（如防除以零的 eps 与 log-sum-exp 技巧）。

prompts.title_zh: 网络小说世界观设定与主角角色一致性锁
prompts.purpose_zh: 长篇小说架构与人物性格防崩塌
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名资深网络小说白金作家与 IP 世界观架构师。请为一部 {{题材分类}} 长篇作品构建骨架并锁定人物一致性：

1. 【世界底座】：定义力量/经济体系、战力天花板与不可违背的底层物理/法则约束，杜绝战力膨胀；
2. 【角色一致性锚点 (Character Lock)】：为主角制定外貌锚定词、口头禅、下意识动作与绝对动机准则（在任何生死抉择时绝不背离该准则）；
3. 【核心驱动力】：设计主角获得的 {{核心金手指}} 与 {{世界核心矛盾}} 之间的冲突循环；
4. 【前三章切入大纲】：黄金三章节奏设计（第1章破局、第2章显露冰山一角、第3章设立首个必胜目标）。
prompts.prompt_content_en: Build a cohesive, non-contradictory fiction universe and establish an immutable character anchor rule (appearance, decision heuristics, core motivation) to prevent personality drift over long chapters.

sample_output.title: 世界观与人物锚定卡样本
sample_output.content:
【主角核心锚定卡 · 陆沉】
- 外貌指纹（跨章恒定）：右耳一枚黑曜石碎骨钉，习惯性单手插兜，左眉峰有浅淡刀痕。
- 决策第一公理："利益可以出让，但绝不签署不可撤销的信任协议"——任何试图以情感道德绑架他的剧情，他必做出理性防卫。

【力量体系底层法理】
- 机制：灵能不是无限提取，而是向未来"借贷"。借贷三级灵能，必在72小时内遭遇相应量级的反噬因果。

【第一章：断头宴上的借贷合同】
陆沉在家族庆功宴上被夺去嫡系席位，当众被赐饮散灵酒。陆沉不动声色饮下，却在体内发动首次因果置换，借来三年后的金丹级肉身力量，捏碎验灵石，反客为主。

prompts.takeaway_zh: 专为终端 Agent 开发者设计的降本提效配方：包含静默自动化运行、单次长上下文压缩避坑参数、以及防止无限递归调用破坏生产环境的安全沙箱命令组合。
prompts.takeaway_en: Production CLI playbook for Claude Code: non-interactive pipeline commands, context window compression flags, and strict dry-run permission safeguards.
prompts.code_snippet:
# 1. 启动项目自动化分析与上下文轻量修剪 (避免上下文爆炸)
claude --compact

# 2. 静默批量执行单元测试与自动修复任务 (CI/CD 友好模式)
claude -p "Run all failing tests under tests/ and apply minimal surgical fixes. Do not touch unrelated files."

# 3. 指定单文件隔离审查模式 (限制仅允许读取特定子目录)
claude --allowed-tools "View,Replace,RunCommand" \
  --dangerously-skip-permissions false \
  -p "Audit security vulnerabilities in auth.py and output remediation report."

# 4. 自动化提交并生成符合 Conventional Commits 规范的 Commit 信息
claude -p "Generate a git commit message following Conventional Commits format for staged changes."

prompts.title_en: Excel Advanced Report & Key Drivers Attribution
prompts.purpose_zh: 业务数据指标异动排查与趋势归因
prompts.prompt_content_zh:
你是一名麦肯锡级别的高级商业数据分析师，精通结构化因果归因与杜邦拆解分析。

针对我提供的 {{业务指标}} 数据，其近期出现 {{异常表现}}，请按以下框架深度剖析：
1. 【指标公式拆解】：将该指标拆分为 3~4 个下级核心因子（如转化率、客单价、复购周期），指出哪个因子波动贡献率最大；
2. 【多维下钻 (Drill-down)】：从 {{维度拆解}}（如渠道、地域、品类、新老客）分析异常聚集点；
3. 【可执行建议】：摒弃假大空的套话，给出接下来 48 小时内的 3 个立竿见影的动作与 1 个监控预警公式。
prompts.prompt_content_en: You are a senior business intelligence analyst. Dissect the metric anomaly into component drivers, perform multi-dimensional drill-down, and deliver prioritized, actionable remediation steps.

sample_output.title: 归因分析报告样本：Q3 付费转化率环比下跌 14.2%
sample_output.content:
【核心发现】：GMV 下跌 14.2% 的主要驱动因子并非流量锐减，而是【结算跳失率】从 18% 飙升至 34%。

【杜邦拆解贡献率分析】：
1. 渠道维度：自然搜索量稳定（波动 <2%），但付费投流渠道跳出率贡献了 72% 的下跌额度；
2. 终端维度：移动端 iOS 表现正常，Android Web 呈现断崖式报错，核心原因是新版本结账 SDK 在低内存机型发生闪退。

【48小时纠偏行动】：
- 动作1 (技术)：立即灰度回滚 Android 渠道结账前端包至 v2.4.1；
- 动作2 (运营)：向受影响但未支付成功的 1,420 位加购用户推送 5 元免门槛补偿券唤醒；
- 动作3 (预警)：在 Grafana 建立警报公式：`IF(Cart_to_Checkout_Ratio < 0.65, Alert_P0, Normal)`。

prompts.takeaway_zh: 解决消费级显卡（RTX 4060/4090/Mac M系列）部署 DeepSeek-R1 时显存溢出（OOM）与思维链无限复读问题的精调 Modelfile 参数配置。
prompts.takeaway_en: Optimized Ollama Modelfile for running DeepSeek-R1 on consumer GPUs (RTX 4090/Mac M-series) without OOM or infinite reasoning loops.
prompts.code_snippet:
# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. 显存与上下文窗口优化：分配 16k 上下文并开启 KV Cache 压缩
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. 避免思维链自旋死循环的核心解码超参
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

# 3. 强力系统提示词：约束必须直接在 <think> 标签内进行深度反思，结束立刻给出最终结果
SYSTEM """
You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

prompts.usage_guide_en: Save as Modelfile, then run 'ollama create deepseek-r1-opt -f Modelfile'. Delivers stable reasoning with low VRAM footprint and no loop loops.

# Modelfile: Optimized DeepSeek-R1 Deployment
FROM deepseek-r1:14b-qwen-distill-q4_K_M

# 1. Video memory and context window optimization: allocate 16k context and enable KV Cache compression
PARAMETER num_ctx 16384
PARAMETER num_predict 4096

# 2. Core decoding hyperparameters to avoid the endless spin loop of the thinking chain
PARAMETER temperature 0.6
PARAMETER top_p 0.95
PARAMETER repeat_penalty 1.15

You are an expert autonomous reasoning AI. Think carefully through the problem step by step inside <think>...</think> tags.
Once reasoning is complete, provide the concise, direct, and actionable answer immediately without repeating reasoning steps.
"""

viral_posts.title_en:
For AGI to benefit all of humanity, it should help people with the everyday tasks that matter most to them. So we built LifeVal, a new benchmark shaped by feedback from thousands of ChatGPT users on where they most want help from a personal assistant—from finding childcare to accessing government services to managing personal finances.

Over the past year, we’ve used LifeVal to measure and improve how well our models handle these everyday tasks.

viral_posts.title_en:
Anything that holds money draws attackers who don't mind trying again.

I learned that the expensive way. I read on X that the Ostium vault I was in had been hacked, opened my wallet, and about $2,000 was gone.

AI agents with wallets have it worse, because the attacker only has to send them words. The trick has a name, prompt injection: an order slipped into ordinary text that the AI then follows.

In May 2026 one of those orders came disguised as Morse code, and around $200,000 left an agent's wallet.

As an engineer, I know a setup that stays the same every time will eventually show its weak spot to someone who keeps trying. That agent had one filter and one model, unchanged on every try.

@GenLayer's Greyboxing takes that sameness away. Its validators are the separate reviewers that run the network.

Before any AI reads your text, each one reworks it in its own hidden way, with its own model. What fools one of them looks like nonsense to everyone else, and the majority overrules any one that slips.

Every try now lands on a reader the attacker has never seen.

Would you let an AI agent hold your money today, or only once it works like this?

I did not have to open Unreal Editor at all to make this game. 

Here's how you can set up in a way that you can build an Unreal game without having to use the Editor:

- Write everything in C++, and build maps and assets with code instead of the editor.
- Build and run the game from the command line.

- Close Unreal when you're done.
- Create a .bat file for me to run the game.
